actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to Amazon Safe to Go's Permit to Work training. In this facility, high-risk and non-routine work cannot begin without a valid permit. The permit makes sure every hazard is identified and controlled before the job starts.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: UIPropertyChangeAction
actions.Data: {"text":"In this facility, high-risk and non-routine work cannot begin without a valid permit. The permit makes sure every hazard is identified and controlled before the job starts.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You'll fill the sections of PTW yourself as you work through each high-risk task at this plant. Press the Begin button to start the module.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Begin button to start the module.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Begin button is in front of you. Press it to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before stepping onto the facility floor, everyone on site wears general PPE. It protects your hands from impact, your feet from falling objects, and makes sure moving vehicles can see you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the impact-resistant gloves, safety shoes and reflective jacket and put them on.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up each PPE item and put it on: gloves, safety shoes and reflective jacket.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the highlighted item and bring it to your body to wear it. You need all three before you can enter the floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This is the Permit to Work form. Before we begin, let's go through each section and what gets filled in it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Permit Details. This is where the permit number, date, work location, a short description of the job and the permit's validity time are recorded.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Type of Work needs a description of the high-risk task being carried out: Electrical, Hot Work, Height or Confined Space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hazard Identification. Based on the site inspection, each listed hazard for the task is marked as Present or Absent when an inspection is carried out.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Isolation. For each task, either electrical, which involves isolation of electrical energy, or work at height, which involves area barricading, any kind of isolation performed before the task should be mentioned under this section.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"PPE Required. You will need to tick the protective equipment needed for this specific job, in addition to the general site PPE.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Precautions Checklist. Every precaution listed for the task must be confirmed in place before work begins.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Permit Acceptance. The Receiver signs here to accept responsibility for the job and the crew working under it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Authorization. The Issuer authorizes the permit after the site visit, and the Area In-charge of the work location countersigns it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Handover and Extension. A permit is valid only until shift end. If work must continue, the extension is recorded here with authorization from the Site Lead.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Permit Closure. Once the job is complete and the area is safe, the permit is closed and signed off.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: UIPropertyChangeAction
actions.Data: {"text":"You'll fill these sections yourself as you work through each high-risk task.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You'll fill these sections yourself as you work through each high-risk task. Press the Begin button to start the module.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Begin button to start the module.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Begin button is in front of you. Press it to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Permit to Work is a formal record that controls hazardous work and connects everyone involved in the job. Two key roles carry the permit from start to finish.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"In this training, you will take the role of the Receiver. Touch or point at each person to learn what each role is responsible for.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Issuer initiates the permit and authorizes it only after visiting the site and confirming the work can be done safely.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Receiver, also called the Acceptor, plans, supervises and executes the work safely, and is responsible for the crew working under the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the Issuer and the Receiver to learn each role.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the remaining person to continue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Some jobs in this facility carry a high risk of serious injury. These are called High Risk Operations, and each one needs a permit before work can begin.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There are four HRO areas here. Each one has its own hazards, PPE and precautions. Let's go through them one by one. Touch or point at the electrical work area on the map to find out what it involves.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the highlighted area on the facility map to learn about it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Reach out and touch the highlighted zone on the map, or point at it and select.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A maintenance job has come up at the electrical panel area. Electrical work is high-risk, so a permit is needed before anyone touches the equipment.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look around, point at every source of hazard you can find, and hold the pointer on it until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That isn't a hazard to this job. Look for something that could shock you, catch you or start up while you're working.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That isn't a hazard to this job. Look for something that could shock you, catch you or start up while you're working.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That isn't a hazard to this job. Look for something that could shock you, catch you or start up while you're working.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Point at each highlighted hazard and hold the pointer on it until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look for the highlighted hazards and point at each one until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The permit has to match what is on site. Let's start filling the PTW for this task.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"For electrical work, the first section of the PTW that you will fill is the hazards. Among the listed ones, select the three you just spotted.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That doesn't match what you saw on site. Think back to the inspection and mark it again.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That doesn't match what you saw on site. Think back to the inspection and mark it again.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That doesn't match what you saw on site. Think back to the inspection and mark it again.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That doesn't match what you saw on site. Think back to the inspection and mark it again.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Based on the hazard inspection performed, go ahead and mark each hazard on the PTW.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the highlighted hazards on the permit to mark them.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let us see an accident that could take place if any of the inspection went wrong.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The fuse was never removed. The circuit stayed live, and the machine started while the technician's hands were inside. That was the major reason for this incident.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Filling of the hazards must be followed by filling in the control measures in consultation with a competent person. Let me fill that for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: UIPropertyChangeAction
actions.Data: {"text":"Ensure LOTO is applied. For configuration at the time of port connection, isolate the machine.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"We now need to fill the isolation section.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If an isolation is required for the task, you have to mark it as yes. Can you go ahead and do it?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"For today, we are isolating this panel, so grab the lock with the hasp and apply it on the electrical panel.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, on the permit, mark the point that says isolator put off and locked, to mandate that it is completed.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Mark all the necessary sections for electrical work on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Mark all the necessary sections for electrical work on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You need to make a note of the lock number and sign it with your name, date and time. Let me do that for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Sections 9 b, 9 c and 9 d are not required for the chosen task, so we can mark NA for them.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"General site PPE isn't enough for electrical work. The permit lists the extra protection this job needs against shock and arc flash.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab and wear the listed PPE provided. Each PPE you wear will be reflected on the PTW automatically.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Wear all the PPE needed for electrical work to fill the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You need electrical gloves, safety shoes, a safety helmet and a reflective jacket. Wear each one.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, take a look at the filled PPE section. For this task, these are the PPEs that are required.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hazards and PPE alone don't make a job safe. The precautions on the permit must be confirmed in place before anyone starts work.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This would be the last section for an electrical energy permit. We have removed the fuse and tagged out the area. Touch these precautions on the checklist to confirm.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch each precaution on the permit to confirm it is in place.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, we have filled all the sections for the electrical permit. The number of people working on the job has to be mentioned and after the work is completed the PTW has to be duly signed.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Move to the Hot Work Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's take time to understand the other sections of the PTW and move to the welding and grinding task. Touch or point at it on the map.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the hot work area on the map to move there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the hot work area on the map to move there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the hot work area on the map to move there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now in this section, let's see how the same PTW has to be filled for hot work, like a cage cart modification. Before filling the hot work permit, inspect the site.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look around, point at the 5 hazards you can find in the cage cart welding area, and hold the pointer on each one until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Point at each highlighted hazard in the hot work area and hold the pointer on it until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Point at each highlighted hazard in the hot work area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great work, you have identified all the hazards. Let me mark them on the PTW for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welding and grinding throw out sparks, intense light, hot metal and noise. The PPE for this job has to protect against all of them.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You are already wearing gloves, goggles, a reflective jacket and safety shoes, so mark them on the PTW. Then grab and wear the welding apron, welding shield, ear plugs and goggles from the table.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Select all the PPE needed for hot work on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Mark the highlighted PPE on the PTW, then grab and wear the highlighted PPE.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The PPE you wore now should also be updated on the permit. Let me do that for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"To ensure a safe hot work area, let's also note down the precautions to be taken.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Mark the precautions that are already in place. Under general, the job site is checked and PPE is provided. Under hot work, mark the hot work location, the protective screens and electrode cables, and the fire-fighting equipment and team.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch each hot work precaution on the permit to verify it is in place.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A few other things to be filled include the status of the flammable materials, authorisation certificate of the welder, cable and hose conditions, and area barricading. These change depending on the job which you would perform. For now, let me take care of that.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hazards, precautions and PPE for the hot work job are all recorded. Signing confirms you accept responsibility for this job and the crew working under it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the pen and sign the Permit Acceptance block.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the pen and sign the Permit Acceptance block on the hot work permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the pen and bring it to the highlighted Permit Acceptance block to sign.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, good job with the work permit for hot work. One thing to understand is that a permit is valid only until the end of the shift, until 6:30 pm. If work has to continue beyond that, the permit must be extended, with authorization from the Site Lead.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Move to the Work at Height Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The next job needs a ladder and scaffold to reach equipment overhead. Falls from height are among the most serious injuries on any site, so this work needs its own permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's move to the work at height area. Touch or point at it on the map to go there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the work at height area on the map to go there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the work at height area on the map to go there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Identify the Hazards: Work at Height

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before filling the height permit, inspect the site. Anything that could make someone fall, or drop something on the people below, must be identified first.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look around, point at each hazard source you can find, and hold the pointer on it until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Point at each highlighted hazard in the work at height area and hold the pointer on it until it is marked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Point at each highlighted hazard: elevated work, unsafe access, objects overhead and exposed wiring.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great, now let me add that to the PTW.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Anything dropped from height, like a tool, a cable tie or a loose bracket, lands in the area below. The work area has to be closed off so no one walks under the job while it's in progress.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the barricading cone and place it at the highlighted marked corner, around the area below the work point.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, now let me place the remaining for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Place a barricade cone at the highlighted marked corner.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the highlighted cone and place it on the glowing marker. The whole area below the job must be closed off.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Under area isolation, we should also write down that barricading has been added. Let me do that for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Select PPE for Work at Height

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, select and wear the PPE for work at height to update the PTW with the same.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Wear all the required PPE to get it filled on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Wear all the required PPE to get it filled on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"These listed precautions under the PTW for work at height make sure the access, the anchorage and the conditions are safe before anyone climbs.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch each precaution on the checklist to verify it is in place.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch each work at height precaution on the permit to verify it is in place.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the highlighted precaution. All of them must be verified before anyone climbs.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Depending on the type of work, the other precautions also apply when filling the PTW for work at height. Make sure the emergency response checklist is also filled.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Move to the Confined Space Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"We are almost done with all sections of the PTW. The last job is inside the conveyor motor area with a single manhole entry, which is a confined space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the confined space area on the map to move to its entry point.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the confined space area on the map to go to its entry point.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch or point at the confined space area on the map to go to its entry point.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, you know the drill for PPE. Select and wear the PPE for confined spaces to update the PTW with the same.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Wear all the required PPE to get it filled on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Wear all the required PPE to get it filled on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Inside the tank, hazards are often invisible. You can't see a lack of oxygen or smell every toxic gas, so inspect carefully.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's mark all the hazards now for confined spaces.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Mark each confined space hazard on the permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good, we have identified all hazards and verified them on site.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"No one enters a confined space until the air is proven safe and a rescue plan is ready. These checks are completed and recorded before entry.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Under the precautions, let's enter some values. Tap on each section to fill it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Oxygen must stay between 19.5 and 23.5 percent, carbon monoxide below 25 ppm, hydrogen sulphide below 10 ppm.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Low voltage and flame-proof, so it can't shock or ignite gas.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"An attendant or a standby person should be present.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch each pre-work step on the permit to review it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the highlighted pre-work step to review it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. The rest of the slots under the confined spaces section will be filled or left out based on the type of task. But remember to fill them completely depending on the assigned task.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pre-work checks and hazards for the confined space are all recorded. Signing confirms you accept responsibility for this job and everyone who enters the space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the pen and sign the Permit Acceptance block.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the pen and sign the Permit Acceptance block on the confined space permit.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the pen and bring it to the highlighted Permit Acceptance block to sign.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You have successfully completed the PTW module covering all the high risk operations including electrical safety, hot work, confined spaces and work at height. Good job!","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
